hook.name: SATOHook
hook.description: A bonding-curve AMM hook that replaces standard Uniswap v4 swap mechanics entirely within `beforeSwap`. Buys mint SATO tokens according to an exponential saturation curve and compound the full BNB input into the curve reserve; sells burn SATO tokens and return BNB. Liquidity additions are forbidden, and `hookData` must encode the swapper address for cooldown and entropy tracking.
